notes.decision: Translated as 'they reckon them and receive them.' ⲥⲉⲟⲁⲡⲟⲩ from ⲱⲡ 'count, reckon' (in glossary) with 3pl object; ⲛⲥⲉϣⲁⲡⲟⲩ from ϣⲱⲡ 'receive' with 3pl object. The cosmic-juridical register (counting + receiving) fits the angelic management of souls being processed through the transmigration cycle.
Standard Coptic idiom 'a stripping naked' (cf. accumulated ⲕⲱⲕ ⲁⲍⲏⲩ). The cosmic refinement is here described as a stripping-bare of the soul from its bodily/archonic integument.

Read as Lyc. variant of Sahidic ⲥⲱϫⲡ̄ 'leave behind, leave remaining.' The construction ϣⲁⲩⲥⲱⲭⲛ̄ ⲁⲡⲁⲍⲟⲩ ⲛ̄ⲧⲟⲟⲧⲟⲩ 'they habitually leave behind from out of their hand' fits the soul-residue motif. ⲭ for ϫ is regular Lyc.
Read as Lyc. reflex of ⲡⲱϩ/ⲧⲣⲉ-ⲡⲱϩ 'reach, attain' (causative or strong-form). The relative-future ⲉⲧⲟⲩⲛⲁⲧⲉⲍⲁϩ = 'in which they will reach.' Distinct from ⲧⲉϩⲟ 'to reach' in glossary.

Read tentatively as Lyc. ϫⲱⲱⲙⲉ/ⲱⲱⲙⲉ 'swallow' or related — fits the metempsychosis motif of the souls being absorbed into the begetting. Translation 'they swallow' supplies a tentative verb governing the surviving form. Confidence low.
Translated 'transfer/take them' from ⲟⲩⲱⲧⲃ̄ 'pass over, transfer' (Lyc.) — captures the angels' translation of the captive souls into their own midst, parallel to ⲁⲧⲟⲩⲙⲏⲧⲉ in next line.

ⲁⲁⲙⲱⲛ identified as Lyc. orthographic reduction of ⲇⲁⲓⲙⲱⲛ 'demons' (Greek δαίμων, in glossary). The cosmogonic act of casting the demons upward to the seven foundation-trenches outside the cosmos matches the standard Manichaean schema of expelling dark substance to the cosmic edge.

Parsed ⲁ-ⲟⲩ-ⲱⲱⲡⲉ 'unto a being/becoming of archons' — i.e., 'in the form of/disguised as archons.' ⲱⲱⲡⲉ = ϣⲱⲡⲉ 'become' (cf. accumulated ⲱⲱⲡⲉ ⲉⲧⲉⲧⲛ̄ⲥⲁⲩⲛⲉ). The angels are sent in archonic guise to police the archons' transgressions.

Obscure verbal form. Tentatively rendered 'watching over them' on contextual grounds — pairs with the restored ⲛⲟⲩⲛ̄ⲃⲁⲗ 'their eyes' and the upcoming 'until the hour in which' marker of vigilant watching. Possibly Lyc. reflex of ϫⲱϣⲧ̄ 'look upon, watch' (with ⲭ for ϫ) with feminine object suffix referring to a singular collective. Confidence low.

Read as Lyc. reflex of ⲟⲩⲱⲑ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'wipe out, dissolve, pour forth' (cf. accumulated entry); -ⲟⲩ is 3pl object suffix. The angels pour the refined souls forth from the upper place to be re-stationed in their original forms/icons — eschatological recapitulation.

Translated 'they swallow them' from ⲱⲙⲕ̄ 'swallow, devour' with 3pl object suffix. The archons swallow the bodies/souls in the begetting-cycle of flesh — the cosmic devouring of light-particles by archonic procreation.
